claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Necrostatin-1 is a selective allosteric RIPK1 inhibitor that blocks necroptosis rather than killing cells, so at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive as a cytotoxic agent in a 5-day pooled viability screen.
